description: This file defines a report parser class for account journal reports in Odoo, including methods for retrieving journal lines and calculating sums of debit and credit amounts.

classes.name: journal_print
classes.description: A report parser class for generating account journal period reports, providing methods to fetch journal lines and sum debit/credit amounts.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser with context and updates local context with helper functions.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Retrieves journal move lines for specified periods and journals, updating their state to 'printed'.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates the total debit amount for a given period and journal.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates the total credit amount for a given period and journal.
